57
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the March 3, 2006/Phalguna 12, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests; Food Processing
Industries; Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
Benefits to farmers from rising
market prices
*181. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that farmers are
not benefiting from rising market prices of
wheat as the middlemen are raking all the
profits;
(b) whether Government have a plan to
ensure that farmers get adequate benefit
from higher market prices of their crops;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Sea food parks in coastal areas
*182. SHRI RAJU PARMAR: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to develop sea food parks in coastal areas;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether these parks are very
popular the world over; and
(d) if so, whether Government propose
to have joint venture with foreign firms for
development of such parks and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Utilization of Railway Safety Fund for
road safety works
*183. SHRI R.K. ANAND:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Railway
Safety Fund was created to finance works
relating to road safety measures and if so,
the reasons for not using the funds for
safety purposes;
(b) whether a train mowed a trolley at
the unmanned railway crossing near
Nagpur recently killing fifty five persons;
and
(c) if so, whether the matter has been
inquired into to bring to book the authorities
responsible for not using the Railway
Safety Fund for the purpose it was created?

58
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Unauthorized structures in wild life
sanctuaries
*184. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that unauthorized
structures violative of Revenue Act within
the precincts of Ranthambore National
Sanctuary have been demolished;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the other wild life sanctuaries and
national parks where unauthorized
structures exist in their precincts; and
(d) what is Government’s plan to free
them from unauthorized land use to ensure
safety of wild animals?
Laying of Gwalior-Etawah
rail line
†*185. SHRI LAXMINARAYAN
SHARMA: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to lay railway line between Gwalior and
Etawah (U.P.);
(b) if so, by when the project is likely
to be completed; and
(c) what are the details thereof?
Implementation of CGHS in Andhra
Pradesh
*186. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of implementation of the
Central Government Health Scheme in
Andhra Pradesh during the last three years,
year-wise and location-wise;
(b) the details of new CGHS
dispensaries proposed to be opened in the
State, location-wise; and
(c) the details of expenditure incurred
by Government on various Central Health
Schemes during the last three years, year-
wise?
Development of marketing
centres
†*187. SHRIMATI  KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are going to
develop eight ‘state of the art’ marketing
centres for marketing of agricultural
products;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the States where these centres are
likely to be set up and the details of the
resources of their funding?
Purchasing of Khadi and Kulhad by
Railways
†*188. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of Khadi and Kulhad
purchased by Railways, so far, after the
announcement of the budget, 2004;
(b) whether Railways propose to serve
meals in thalis and donas made of ‘Saal’
leaves on the pattern of Khadi and Kulhad;
and
(c) if so, by when and the steps to be
taken in this regard?

59
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Rejection of Indian Chyavanprash by
Singapore
†*189. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Singapore
has returned Indian Chyavanprash
considering it as dangerous;
(b) whether it is also a fact that prior to
this incident, America had also returned
Indian Ayurvedic medicines with similar
allegation;
(c) if so, the action taken by Government
in this regard;
(d) whether, in order to check repetition
of such negligence, Government would
consider to set up an effective authority
after dissolving the Central Medicinal Plant
Board; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Conversion of single railway lines
into double railway lines in Bihar

Organic manures
†1174. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the use of excessive
quantity of chemical fertilizers and plant
protective chemicals for more production
from the advanced varieties in agriculture
sector in the country, is adversely affecting
human health on one hand and on the other
fertility of the agriculture land;
(b) whether the manure invented by the
scientists of National Botanical Research
Institute, Lucknow and Bovine Science
Research Centre, Nagpur, with the help of
ancient Indian Book "Vishwa Vallabha’’  has
been patented by America;
(c) whether expected results could not
be achieved in respect of organic manures;
and
(d) if so, the details of action taken by
Government in this regard?
Production of mustard seeds
†1175. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
production of mustard (edible oilseeds) in
Rabi crops is likely to be more duing
2005-2006 as compared to the last year;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and whether
it is a fact that due to over production,
genuine producers will be forced to sell their
produce less than the minimum support
price; and
(c) if not, the provision made by
Government therefor alongwith the
arrangements made to procure mustard at
minimum support price?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

267
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Development of rainfed areas
1176. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
steady decline in the agricultural produce
and water tables are shrinking in the rainfed
areas of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that poverty
and distress are rampant in the rainfed areas;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government propose to set
up a national Authority for Sustainable
Development of Rainfed Areas for
managing all the watershed programmes
funded by Government; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Joining the Indian Ocean Tuna
Organization
1177. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that our country
has joined the Indian Ocean Tuna
Organization;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the objectives and other salient
features of this organization?
Employment in agriculture sector
†1178. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that employment
opportunities have decreased in the
agriculture sector in the country particularly
in the Himachal Pradesh during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the amount allocated by Government
under Swarnjayanti Gram Swarozgar
Yojana, Jawahar Gram Samridhi Yojana and
Employment Assurance Scheme
respectively to increase the employment
opportunities in rural areas in the State
during the last three years and the amount
spent out of that during that period?
Foodgrain production
1179. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are going to downscale the foodgrain
production to 215 million tonnes in 2005-06;
(b) the actual target set for Kharif and
Rabi seasons of the year, separately; and
(c) the reasons for downscaling the
production?
Modernisation of ports
1180. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether, in order to give a fillip to
the fisheries trade in the Konkan region,
Government propose to modernize six
ports viz., Arnala, Jivana, Agardanda,
Sakirnara and Harne;
(b) whether such fisheries development
projects in the ports in other States are
also planned;

(c) if so, the details of the project
proposals and cost thereof; and
(d) the steps, so far, taken in this regard?
Declining wheat production in
Punjab
†1181. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that country's
largest wheat producing State Punjab has
registered a decline in wheat production
during the last few years;
(b) if so, per hectare wheat production
from the years 1999-2000 to 2004-2005;
and
(c) the reasons for decline in production
rate and how it has affected profit-margins
of farmers?
